static_traits.name: Fang Shan
static_traits.social_status: Growing distant from friends and family; has supportive friends but has not yet discussed school-related issues
static_traits.medical_history: Previously had similar feelings of academic pressure and stress but not this severe; has not yet received psychotherapy or counseling; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, high cooperation, able to specifically describe triggering situations and feelings; markedly negative self-evaluation, often using words like 'despair, hopelessness'; speech-rate and logic details not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: I hate school and have formed the belief 'I will never be able to graduate', which makes me feel despair and hopelessness.
basic_info.core_demands: Persistent negative thoughts and declining academic performance have made me realize I need counseling to address these issues affecting my future. I want to find ways to cope with these thoughts and feel better about school and myself.
growth_experiences: At the start of high school, the client developed a strong dislike of school and formed the belief 'I will never be able to graduate'. Pressure from keeping up with schoolwork and peer performance expectations has recently intensified. Due to stress and worry that 'no matter what, I am not good enough', the client's grades dropped and she often skips school; in daily life before going to school or when needing to study or prepare for exams, strong negative automatic thoughts arise (despair, hopelessness). She is gradually growing distant from friends and family; although she has supportive friends, she has not yet discussed school-related issues with them; she tried improving grades and attendance but failed due to insufficient motivation and stress. She has not yet received any psychotherapy or counseling, and has no major physical illness history.

core_beliefs: I am worthless / I have no value
I am doomed never to succeed (never able to graduate)

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not do well on this exam, it proves I am not good enough and my future will be ruined
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Skipping school, avoiding exam-prep and learning tasks, to reduce current anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If I do not do well this time I am done; I will never be able to graduate

special_situations.event: Receiving a report card lower than expected
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If grades are lower than expected, it means I am a failure and will keep failing in the future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Briefly trying to improve attendance and learning to 'prove oneself', but soon giving up due to stress and powerlessness
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am just a failure; I can never catch up with others

special_situations.event: Sees friends or classmates perform very well and achieve good results
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am not like my peers, it means I am no good and worthless; being surpassed by them is my failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduced socializing, growing distant from friends and family, to avoid comparison and being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as them; I can never compare to them

special_situations.event: Every day before school or when needing to study and do homework
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot maintain motivation to study, it means I am doomed never to graduate
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Procrastinating or skipping school, temporarily escaping learning situations to relieve anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot do it; I am doomed never to graduate

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized as capable, graduating smoothly and having a valuable future
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure and being judged, unable to be self-reliant, worrying the future will be terrible
defense_goal: Reducing anxiety by avoiding school-related situations
Keeps distance from others to avoid comparison and shame
Temporarily rebuilds self-worth through working to improve grades and attendance

object_relations.self_representation: A self that is not good enough and prone to failure
object_relations.object_representation: Others (peers, family, teachers) are harsh judges and comparers

manifestations: Seeing academic failure as 'a ruined life', believing one 'will never be able to graduate or do anything worthwhile'
Full of despair and hopelessness about the future
Growing distant from friends and family
Having supportive friends but unwilling to discuss school-related issues

positive_force: Having supportive friends to confide in (though not yet approached)
Has passed courses through effort before, with an evidence base of some success experience
Has actively sought counseling and help, positive attitude, willing to try strategies
Able to identify and express one's triggering situations and negative thinking, with self-observation ability
negative_force: Negative cognitive patterns such as catastrophizing, overgeneralization, all-or-nothing stand out
Core beliefs 'I am not good enough' and 'I will not succeed' reinforcing self-denial
Skipping school and study avoidance maintaining the problem cycle
Growing distant from friends and family, external support not yet utilized
Increasing stress from peer comparison and being judged; inferiority and hopelessness

antecedent: Before school or when study/exam time approaches
Seeing peers get good grades or perform excellently
target_behavior.core_reason: Driven by the core belief 'I am not good enough / doomed to fail', producing catastrophizing and future-predicting cognitions; strong anxiety drives avoidance to reduce being judged and feelings of failure
target_behavior.function: Escaping perceived failure and negative evaluation, briefly relieving anxiety and shame
target_behavior.consequence: Academic performance declining further, increasing worry about 'being unable to graduate', increased despair, daily routine disrupted

antecedent: When seeing friends or classmates perform well
When thinking of others' expectations or evaluations of one's studies
target_behavior.core_reason: Comparing with others triggers inferiority and worthlessness; fearing exposure of failure and being judged
target_behavior.function: Avoids comparison and negative evaluation, maintaining fragile self-esteem and a sense of safety
target_behavior.consequence: Social support not yet utilized, increased subjective loneliness, negative emotions persisting and worsening
